name: OpenCL 2.0 Memory Model
description: A scoped extension of the C11 model for heterogeneous compute, adding memory scopes (work-item, work-group, device, all-SVM-devices) on top of C11's atomic orderings. At all-devices scope it coincides with C11; narrower scopes permit additional weak behaviours. Formalised and repaired alongside C11 by Batty, Donaldson & Wickerson (POPL 2016).

catSupport.note: The scoped OpenCL model is given in herd's bell/cat framework — scopes were added to cat for exactly this family (Alglave et al. 2015) — and run under herd7. The zoo's own scoped-GPU witnesses use herd7's plain C11 model as a proxy (cross-scope synchronisation degenerates to relaxed), not this cat model.
